lines: # ERCapacityExpansion (MIT, KamiyamaShiki0704): raises the animation limit. Loaded before Seamless Co-op.
# Nightreign Movement native for BOTH Convergence profiles (me3\convergence.me3 and me3\convergence - seamless.me3), appended as the LAST native.
# initializer is mandatory: without it me3 loads an inert DLL (NRM_MERGEABILITY B6). Remove any older NightreignMovement*.dll entry first.

load_after = [{ id = "ersc.dll", optional = true }, { id = "eldenring_alt_saves.dll", optional = true }, { id = "ErdTools.dll", optional = true }, { id = "erdyes.dll", optional = true }, { id = "ertransmogrify.dll", optional = true }, { id = "Scripts-Data-Exposer-FS.dll", optional = true }, { id = "er_torrent_skin_slots.dll", optional = true }, { id = "unlock_wwise_states_er.dll", optional = true }, { id = "MapForGoblins.dll", optional = true }, { id = "infinite_arrows.dll", optional = true }]
